title: Ads and pop-ups, gone
caption: DevShield blocks ads, trackers and pop-unders on every site and shows what it stopped.

title: Read the page, not the ads
caption: Ad slots, sponsored widgets and tracking scripts are removed before they load.

title: Every blocked pop-up, logged
caption: See which pop-ups and redirects were stopped, and open one anyway if you wanted it.

title: Trusted filter lists built in
caption: EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock filters and regional lists run inside Chrome itself.

title: Bring your uBlock filters along
caption: Import "My filters" or a backup from uBlock Origin or AdGuard in one click.

title: Undo a hidden element in one click
caption: The popup lists what you hid or allowed on this site. Remove one and reload. Light or dark follows your system.

title: Know which filters really work
caption: After Apply or Import, DevShield lists the lines Chrome cannot use, with the line number and the reason.
